title: abelmoschus moschatus var. haenkeanus
intro: Abelmoschus moschatus var. haenkeanus, commonly known as the Chinese rose mallow or Abelmoschus haenkeanus, is a plant species belonging to the mallow family (Malvaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to treat digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Abelmoschus moschatus var. haenkeanus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
